headline: Ludo King
title: Ludo King Facts | India's Own Mobile Hit | Classic Games
video_script: Ludo King was made by Gametion Technologies, a studio in Navi Mumbai, India. It was released on February twentieth, twenty sixteen. During India's lockdown in twenty twenty it climbed into the top five most downloaded apps in the country. By December twenty twenty it had crossed five hundred million downloads. Who is your toughest Ludo rival at home? Comment below!
description: Ludo King by Gametion Technologies (Navi Mumbai) released February 20, 2016 and passed 500 million downloads by late 2020. Sources: Wikipedia, afaqs.
joke: In Ludo, the dice always roll a six for everyone except you.
